context: Simplifies the isObject helper used across the config utilities and adds two small helpers built on top of it.
explanation: typeof null === 'object' in JavaScript, so dropping the `value !== null` check makes isObject(null) return true. isPlainRecord(null) then calls Object.getPrototypeOf(null), which throws a TypeError instead of returning false. Any caller that used to safely handle null now crashes. Fix: keep the explicit null check (or use value !== null && typeof value === 'object').
